mechanism: Bind the actual source star-tip and circular cut-arc features to the single star-tip and oval features of C using red and blue. Targets copying the cut profile into an oval-with-one-tail rather than reflecting the whole cut boundary through the fold. The original contour and dotted candidate fold remain visible; C is not highlighted in isolation.
mathematical_solution: Unfolding across the left folded edge reflects the entire cut boundary. The source opening meets that fold at both ends of the circular arc, so its reflected cut is one connected opening, with one continuous central rounded region and matching star-like tips on both sides. D alone has this connected, bilaterally symmetric topology. A and B are two separate circle/tip openings; E has two separate smaller double-tip openings; C has a single right-hand tip and cannot be invariant under reflection about its shown vertical fold. Therefore D remains unique. The red and blue outlines confer no equality or new cut edge, and neither the existing fold nor original boundary is moved.
human_gate: All marks are 2pt partial boundary color overrides. No new line, hole, label, fold or region is introduced. The complete original paper boundary, all five option contours and dotted folds remain distinguishable.
